BiblicalUsage: Amos says God will bring up baldness upon every head, as the mourning of an only son, and the law says ye shall not make any baldness between your eyes for the dead. The word is the baldness itself, a sign of grief and of mourning.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe baldness for the dead is forbidden because God's people do not grieve like the nations, and the sign is on the head.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
